@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
public class Prosopagnosia {
	private static Holder<MobEffect> cachedEffectHolder = null;
	private static boolean effectHolderSearched = false;

	public static boolean isBackwoodsEntity(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return false;
		}
		try {
			ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType());
			if (id != null && "the_backwoods".equals(id.getNamespace())) {
				return true;
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}
		return entity.getClass().getName().startsWith("net.mcreator.thebackwoods");
	}

	public static void purgeProsopagnosia(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return;
		}

		try {
			if (entity.hasEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT)) {
				entity.removeEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT);
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		if (cachedEffectHolder != null && entity.hasEffect(cachedEffectHolder)) {
			try {
				entity.removeEffect(cachedEffectHolder);
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}
		}

		if (!entity.getActiveEffects().isEmpty()) {
			for (MobEffectInstance effect : new ArrayList<>(entity.getActiveEffects())) {
				Holder<MobEffect> holder = effect.getEffect();
				ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
				if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
					try {
						entity.removeEffect(holder);
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
				}
			}
		}

		try {
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("prosopagnosia_active")) {
				entity.getPersistentData().remove("prosopagnosia_active");
			}
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("prosopagnosia_hallucination")) {
				entity.getPersistentData().remove("prosopagnosia_hallucination");
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}
	}

	public static boolean hasProsopagnosia(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return false;
		}

		// Mod ID entities are completely immune to Prosopagnosia: immediately purge if applied
		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			purgeProsopagnosia(entity);
			return false;
		}

		if (!entity.getActiveEffects().isEmpty()) {
			try {
				if (entity.hasEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT)) {
					return true;
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}

			if (!effectHolderSearched) {
				effectHolderSearched = true;
				for (Holder<MobEffect> holder : BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.asHolderIdMap()) {
					ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
					if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
						cachedEffectHolder = holder;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			if (cachedEffectHolder != null && entity.hasEffect(cachedEffectHolder)) {
				return true;
			}

			if (cachedEffectHolder == null) {
				for (MobEffectInstance effect : entity.getActiveEffects()) {
					Holder<MobEffect> holder = effect.getEffect();
					ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
					if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
						cachedEffectHolder = holder;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		try {
			if (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("prosopagnosia_active")) {
				return true;
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		if (event.getEntity() == null) {
			return;
		}

		if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity entity) || entity instanceof Player) {
			return;
		}

		if (entity.level().isClientSide() || !entity.isAlive()) {
			return;
		}

		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			purgeProsopagnosia(entity);
			return;
		}

		if (!hasProsopagnosia(entity)) {
			return;
		}

		// 1. Breakdown of Pack & Protective Instincts
		// Clear aggression, targets, and pack instincts: entity cannot distinguish allies from threats
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			if (mob.getTarget() != null) {
				mob.setTarget(null);
			}
			if (mob.isAggressive()) {
				mob.setAggressive(false);
			}
			if (mob.isSprinting()) {
				mob.setSprinting(false); // Prevents sprinting/walking dust particles under feet
			}
		}

		if (entity instanceof NeutralMob neutral) {
			if (neutral.isAngry() || neutral.getPersistentAngerTarget() != null) {
				neutral.stopBeingAngry();
				neutral.setPersistentAngerTarget(null);
			}
		}

		if (entity instanceof TamableAnimal tamable) {
			if (tamable.isOrderedToSit() || tamable.isInSittingPose()) {
				tamable.setOrderedToSit(false);
				tamable.setInSittingPose(false);
			}
		}

		// 2. Scan for all living entities within paranoid sight range (16 horizontal, 8 vertical)
		AABB scanBox = entity.getBoundingBox().inflate(16.0, 8.0, 16.0);
		List<LivingEntity> nearby = entity.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
			LivingEntity.class,
			scanBox,
			other -> other != entity && other.isAlive() && !other.isSpectator()
				&& !(other instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator()))
		);

		List<LivingEntity> seenThreats = null;
		if (!nearby.isEmpty()) {
			for (LivingEntity other : nearby) {
				// Line of sight check: flees from every entity they see (including pack mates, owners, villagers)
				if (entity.hasLineOfSight(other)) {
					if (seenThreats == null) {
						seenThreats = new ArrayList<>();
					}
					seenThreats.add(other);
				}
			}
		}

		// Read hallucination timer (1.21.1 raw int getter)
		int hallucinationTimer = 0;
		try {
			hallucinationTimer = entity.getPersistentData().getInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination");
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		// Determine if navigation re-pathing is needed this tick
		boolean shouldUpdateNav = false;
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			// Recalculate immediately on collision, routine update every 8 ticks (staggered by entity ID),
			// or when navigation finished/idle check every 4 ticks (staggered) instead of every single tick
			shouldUpdateNav = entity.horizontalCollision
				|| ((entity.tickCount + entity.getId()) % 8 == 0)
				|| (mob.getNavigation().isDone() && ((entity.tickCount + entity.getId()) % 4 == 0));
		}

		// 3. Fleeing logic: Real Threats vs Phantom Hallucinations
		if (seenThreats != null && !seenThreats.isEmpty()) {
			// Real entities seen: clear any phantom hallucination timer because active threats take priority
			if (hallucinationTimer > 0) {
				try {
					entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", 0);
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}
			}

			double entityX = entity.getX();
			double entityZ = entity.getZ();
			double repelX = 0.0;
			double repelZ = 0.0;
			LivingEntity nearestThreat = null;
			double minDistanceSq = Double.MAX_VALUE;

			for (LivingEntity threat : seenThreats) {
				double distSq = entity.distanceToSqr(threat);
				if (distSq < minDistanceSq) {
					minDistanceSq = distSq;
					nearestThreat = threat;
				}

				double dx = entityX - threat.getX();
				double dz = entityZ - threat.getZ();
				double hDistSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
				if (hDistSq > 0.0001) {
					double hDist = Math.sqrt(hDistSq);
					double dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
					double scale = 1.0 / (hDist * Math.max(0.5, dist));
					repelX += dx * scale;
					repelZ += dz * scale;
				}
			}

			Vec3 repelVector;
			double rLenSq = repelX * repelX + repelZ * repelZ;
			if (rLenSq < 0.0001) {
				double rx = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				double rz = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				double rLen = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz);
				if (rLen > 0.0001) {
					repelVector = new Vec3(rx / rLen, 0.0, rz / rLen);
				} else {
					repelVector = new Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
			} else {
				double rLen = Math.sqrt(rLenSq);
				repelVector = new Vec3(repelX / rLen, 0.0, repelZ / rLen);
			}

			Vec3 fleeTarget = entity.position().add(repelVector.scale(14.0));

			if (shouldUpdateNav && entity instanceof PathfinderMob pathfinderMob && nearestThreat != null) {
				try {
					Vec3 randomAway = DefaultRandomPos.getPosAway(pathfinderMob, 16, 7, nearestThreat.position());
					if (randomAway != null) {
						fleeTarget = randomAway;
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}
			}

			executeFleeMovement(entity, fleeTarget, repelVector, shouldUpdateNav);

			// Erratic panicked glances while fleeing: rapidly look back at threats
			if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.30f) {
				if (nearestThreat != null && entity.getRandom().nextBoolean()) {
					mob.getLookControl().setLookAt(nearestThreat.getX(), nearestThreat.getEyeY(), nearestThreat.getZ());
				} else {
					float jitterYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 140.0f;
					mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + jitterYaw);
					mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
				}
			}
		} else {
			// No real entities in sight: Handle Phantom Hallucinations & Paranoid Twitches
			if (hallucinationTimer > 0) {
				hallucinationTimer--;
				try {
					entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", hallucinationTimer);
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}

				// Generate or maintain phantom flee vector away from an imaginary threat
				double px = Math.cos(entity.tickCount * 0.15);
				double pz = Math.sin(entity.tickCount * 0.15);
				if (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.10f) {
					px = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
					pz = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				}
				double pLen = Math.sqrt(px * px + pz * pz);
				Vec3 phantomRepel = pLen > 0.0001 ? new Vec3(px / pLen, 0.0, pz / pLen) : new Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				Vec3 fleeTarget = entity.position().add(phantomRepel.scale(12.0));

				if (shouldUpdateNav && entity instanceof PathfinderMob pathfinderMob) {
					try {
						Vec3 randomAway = DefaultRandomPos.getPos(pathfinderMob, 14, 7);
						if (randomAway != null) {
							fleeTarget = randomAway;
						}
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
				}

				executeFleeMovement(entity, fleeTarget, phantomRepel, shouldUpdateNav);

				// Panicked erratic head jerking during hallucination
				if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.35f) {
					float jitterYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 180.0f;
					mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + jitterYaw);
					mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
				}
			} else {
				// 2% chance per tick (~every 2.5 seconds) to hallucinate a phantom threat in the shadows
				if (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.02f) {
					int newTimer = 30 + entity.getRandom().nextInt(40);
					try {
						entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", newTimer);
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
					// Sudden startle jump
					if (entity.onGround()) {
						entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(0.0, 0.25, 0.0));
					}
				} else {
					// Paranoid idle scanning: frequently look around, checking behind their back
					if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.20f) {
						float twitchYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 160.0f;
						mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + twitchYaw);
						mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void executeFleeMovement(LivingEntity entity, Vec3 fleeTarget, Vec3 escapeDir, boolean shouldUpdateNav) {
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			if (shouldUpdateNav) {
				mob.getNavigation().moveTo(fleeTarget.x, fleeTarget.y, fleeTarget.z, 1.45);
			}
			if (mob.isSprinting()) {
				mob.setSprinting(false); // Ensure no dust/walking particles spawn
			}
		} else {
			// Non-mob / aquatic / flying propulsion push
			Vec3 push = escapeDir.scale(0.035);
			entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(push));
		}

		// Jump panic if obstructed by a wall or obstacle
		if (entity.horizontalCollision && entity.onGround()) {
			entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(0.0, 0.38, 0.0));
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
	public static class ClientEvents {
		public static final boolean PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING = true;
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/oak_biped.png");
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_BIPED_SLIM_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/oak_biped_slim.png");
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_PLANKS_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:textures/block/oak_planks.png");
		private static boolean isRenderingSplinter = false;

		private static boolean isSlimPlayer(Player player) {
		if (player instanceof AbstractClientPlayer clientPlayer) {
			try {
				return clientPlayer.getSkin().model() == net.minecraft.client.resources.PlayerSkin.Model.SLIM
						|| "slim".equalsIgnoreCase(clientPlayer.getSkin().model().id());
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			if (mc.getMusicManager() != null) {
				mc.getMusicManager().stopPlaying();
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlaySound(PlaySoundEvent event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		if (event.getSound() != null) {
			ResourceLocation loc = event.getSound().getLocation();
			if (loc != null && "the_backwoods".equals(loc.getNamespace())) {
				return;
			}

			String name = event.getName() != null ? event.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
			if (name.startsWith("the_backwoods:") || name.contains("the_backwoods")) {
				return;
			}

			SoundSource source = event.getSound().getSource();
			if (source == SoundSource.MUSIC || source == SoundSource.AMBIENT || source == SoundSource.RECORDS) {
				event.setSound(null);
				return;
			}

			String path = loc != null ? loc.getPath().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
			if (name.contains("music") || name.contains("ambient") || path.contains("music") || path.contains("ambient")) {
				event.setSound(null);
			}
		}
	}

	// ---- Fog distance / sky override -------------------------------------------------
	private static final float FOG_START = 56.0f;
	private static final float FOG_END = 96.0f;

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderFog(ViewportEvent.RenderFog event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}
		// leave water / lava / powder snow fog alone
		if (event.getType() != FogType.NONE) {
			return;
		}
		event.setNearPlaneDistance(FOG_START);
		event.setFarPlaneDistance(FOG_END);
		event.setFogShape(FogShape.SPHERE);
		event.setCanceled(true); // required, otherwise vanilla values are used
	}

	/** Covers sky disc, sun, moon, stars (any dimension) with solid black right after the sky is drawn. */
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLevelStage(RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
		if (event.getStage() != RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_SKY) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}
		Matrix4f mv = new Matrix4f(event.getModelViewMatrix());
		Matrix4fStack stack = RenderSystem.getModelViewStack();
		stack.pushMatrix();
		stack.identity();
		RenderSystem.applyModelViewMatrix();
		RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
		RenderSystem.depthMask(false);
		RenderSystem.disableBlend();
		RenderSystem.disableCull();
		RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
		BufferBuilder b = Tesselator.getInstance().begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
		float s = 50.0f;
		float[][] faces = {
			{-s, -s, -s, s, -s, -s, s, s, -s, -s, s, -s},
			{-s, -s, s, s, -s, s, s, s, s, -s, s, s},
			{-s, -s, -s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, s, -s, s, -s},
			{s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, s, s, s, s, s, -s},
			{-s, -s, -s, s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, -s, -s, s},
			{-s, s, -s, s, s, -s, s, s, s, -s, s, s}
		};
		for (float[] f : faces) {
			for (int i = 0; i < 12; i += 3) {
				b.addVertex(mv, f[i], f[i + 1], f[i + 2]).setColor(0, 0, 0, 255);
			}
		}
		BufferUploader.drawWithShader(b.buildOrThrow());
		RenderSystem.enableCull();
		RenderSystem.depthMask(true);
		RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
		stack.popMatrix();
		RenderSystem.applyModelViewMatrix();
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onComputeFogColor(ViewportEvent.ComputeFogColor event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			event.setRed(0.0f);
			event.setGreen(0.0f);
			event.setBlue(0.0f);
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderNameTag(RenderNameTagEvent event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			event.setCanRender(TriState.FALSE);
			event.setContent(Component.empty());
		}
	}

	private static MultiBufferSource wrapBuffers(MultiBufferSource original, ResourceLocation texture, boolean proceduralUv) {
		RenderType splinterType = RenderType.entityCutoutNoCull(texture);
		return renderType -> {
			if (renderType != null) {
				String str = renderType.toString().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
				if (str.contains("atlas") || str.contains("item") || str.contains("block") || str.contains("glint") || str.contains("gui") || str.contains("crumbling") || str.contains("translucent")) {
					return original.getBuffer(renderType);
				}
				if (str.contains("entity") || str.contains("armor") || str.contains("player")) {
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer base = original.getBuffer(splinterType);
					if (proceduralUv) {
						int[] count = new int[]{0};
						return (com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer) java.lang.reflect.Proxy.newProxyInstance(
							com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer.class.getClassLoader(),
							new Class<?>[]{com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer.class},
							(proxy, method, args) -> {
								String name = method.getName();
								if (name.startsWith("vertex") || name.startsWith("addVertex")) {
									count[0]++;
								} else if (name.equals("uv") || name.equals("setUv")) {
									if (args != null && args.length == 2 && args[0] instanceof Number && args[1] instanceof Number) {
										int idx = Math.max(0, count[0] - 1) & 3;
										float nu = (idx == 1 || idx == 2) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
										float nv = (idx == 2 || idx == 3) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
										args[0] = nu;
										args[1] = nv;
									}
								}
								Object res = method.invoke(base, args);
								return res == base ? proxy : res;
							}
						);
					}
					return base;
				}
			}
			return original.getBuffer(renderType);
		};
	}

	private static boolean isBiped(LivingEntity entity, Object renderer) {
		if (entity instanceof Player) {
			return true;
		}

		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			return false;
		}

		// Never replace skeleton skin or non-human shaped mobs (skeletons have bone UVs, illagers/villagers have robes & joined arms, piglins have snouts/ears)
		if (entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.AbstractSkeleton
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.piglin.AbstractPiglin
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.AbstractIllager
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.npc.AbstractVillager
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Witch
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.ZombieVillager) {
			return false;
		}

		// Standard human-shaped zombies (Zombie, Husk, Drowned)
		if (entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Zombie) {
			return true;
		}

		// Safe model check avoiding direct PlayerModel/ZombieModel class references for maximum compatibility
		if (renderer instanceof LivingEntityRenderer<?, ?> livingRenderer) {
			Object model = livingRenderer.getModel();
			if (model != null) {
				String modelName = model.getClass().getSimpleName();
				if (modelName.contains("Player") || modelName.contains("Zombie")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		if (entity != null) {
			String name = entity.getClass().getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
			if (name.contains("splinter")) {
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderPlayerPre(RenderPlayerEvent.Pre event) {
		if (isRenderingSplinter) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		Player target = event.getEntity();
		if (target == null || target == mc.player) {
			return;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			isRenderingSplinter = true;
			PlayerRenderer renderer = event.getRenderer();
			ResourceLocation texture = isSlimPlayer(target) ? OAK_BIPED_SLIM_TEXTURE : OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE;
			MultiBufferSource bufferSource = wrapBuffers(event.getMultiBufferSource(), texture, false);
			PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();

			renderer.render(
				(AbstractClientPlayer) target,
				target.getYRot(),
				event.getPartialTick(),
				poseStack,
				bufferSource,
				event.getPackedLight()
			);
		} finally {
			isRenderingSplinter = false;
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLivingPre(RenderLivingEvent.Pre<?, ?> event) {
		if (isRenderingSplinter) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
		if (entity == null || entity == mc.player || entity instanceof Player || isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			return;
		}

		boolean isBipedMob = isBiped(entity, event.getRenderer());
		if (!PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING && !isBipedMob) {
			return;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			isRenderingSplinter = true;
			@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
			LivingEntityRenderer rawRenderer = (LivingEntityRenderer) event.getRenderer();
			ResourceLocation texture = (!PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING || isBipedMob) ? OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE : OAK_PLANKS_TEXTURE;
			boolean useProceduralUv = PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING && !isBipedMob;
			MultiBufferSource bufferSource = wrapBuffers(event.getMultiBufferSource(), texture, useProceduralUv);
			PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();

			//noinspection unchecked
			rawRenderer.render(
				entity,
				entity.getYRot(),
				event.getPartialTick(),
				poseStack,
				bufferSource,
				event.getPackedLight()
			);
		} finally {
			isRenderingSplinter = false;
		}
	}
} // ClientEvents
} // Prosopagnosia (1.21.1)

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

// 1.21.1 neoforge compatible
import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class RightSideUpCityFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    public RightSideUpCityFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // --- CONFIGURABLE CITY SETTINGS ---
        int floorY = 63;               
        int gridSize = 10;             // Building grid spacing (blocks)

        int minBuildingWidthX  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthX  = 8;   
        int minBuildingWidthZ  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthZ  = 8;   
        int minBuildingLengthY = 20;   
        int maxBuildingLengthY = 50;   

        // Configurable chance out of 100 for a building cell to generate as a hollow shell
        int hollowBuildingChance = 40;  
        // ----------------------------------

        // --- ROUNDABOUT SETTINGS ---
        int macroChunkGrid = 10;       // Spawn a roundabout every 10x10 chunks
        double parkRadius  = 24.0;     // Radius of the roundabout circle in blocks
        // ----------------------------------

        BlockState plankState = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState airState   = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

        // Convert the origin block coordinates to raw chunk grids
        ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunk(origin);
        int minX = origin.getX() & (~15);
        int minZ = origin.getZ() & (~15);
        int chunkX = minX >> 4;
        int chunkZ = minZ >> 4;

        // Find the center chunk coordinates for the current 10x10 macro chunk sector
        int macroSectorX = Math.floorDiv(chunkX, macroChunkGrid);
        int macroSectorZ = Math.floorDiv(chunkZ, macroChunkGrid);
        
        // Find the absolute center block point of the roundabout for this 10x10 chunk macro sector
        int centerRoundaboutX = (macroSectorX * macroChunkGrid + (macroChunkGrid / 2)) * 16 + 8;
        int centerRoundaboutZ = (macroSectorZ * macroChunkGrid + (macroChunkGrid / 2)) * 16 + 8;

        // Single-pass direct buffer generation loop
        for (int rx = 0; rx < 16; rx++) {
            for (int rz = 0; rz < 16; rz++) {
                int blockX = minX + rx;
                int blockZ = minZ + rz;

                // Calculate the exact distance from this block to the roundabout center point
                double dx = blockX - centerRoundaboutX;
                double dz = blockZ - centerRoundaboutZ;
                double distanceToCenter = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

                boolean isInRoundabout = distanceToCenter <= parkRadius;

                // Max clear height for air buffer clearance
                int maxClearY = floorY + maxBuildingLengthY + 5;

                for (int currentY = floorY; currentY <= maxClearY; currentY++) {
                    BlockPos targetPos = new BlockPos(blockX, currentY, blockZ);

                    if (currentY == floorY) {
                        // 1. Foundation Layer Pass - Reverted parameter to false for 1.21.1
                        chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, plankState, false); 
                    } else {
                        // 2. Above-ground Structuring Pass
                        if (isInRoundabout) {
                            // Carve everything within the radius into clear open air space
                            chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, airState, false);
                        } else {
                            // Standard building placement logic
                            int cellX = Math.floorMod(blockX, gridSize);
                            int cellZ = Math.floorMod(blockZ, gridSize);

                            int sectorX = Math.floorDiv(blockX, gridSize);
                            int sectorZ = Math.floorDiv(blockZ, gridSize);
                            
                            long sectorHash = ((long) sectorX * 418731283L) ^ ((long) sectorZ * 13289791L) ^ 84729184L;
                            
                            int bWidthX = minBuildingWidthX + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 4567L) % (maxBuildingWidthX - minBuildingWidthX + 1));
                            int bWidthZ = minBuildingWidthZ + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 9876L) % (maxBuildingWidthZ - minBuildingWidthZ + 1));
                            int bHeight = minBuildingLengthY + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash) % (maxBuildingLengthY - minBuildingLengthY + 1));

                            int dy = currentY - floorY;
                            if (cellX < bWidthX && cellZ < bWidthZ && dy <= bHeight && Math.abs(sectorHash % 100) < 85) {
                                // Determine deterministically if this specific building should be hollow
                                boolean isHollowBuilding = (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 12345L) % 100) < hollowBuildingChance;

                                if (isHollowBuilding) {
                                    // Bounding shell detection mechanics
                                    boolean isOuterWall = (cellX == 0 || cellX == bWidthX - 1 || cellZ == 0 || cellZ == bWidthZ - 1);
                                    boolean isRoofOrFloor = (dy == 1 || dy == bHeight);

                                    if (isOuterWall || isRoofOrFloor) {
                                        chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, plankState, false);
                                    } else {
                                        chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, airState, false); // Inner structural air cavity carve
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, plankState, false);
                                }
                            } else {
                                chunk.setBlockState(targetPos, airState, false); // Clears background noise walls
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

	private static boolean isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller() {
		for (StackTraceElement el : Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()) {
			String cn = el.getClassName();
			if (cn.equals(RotDataGuardian.class.getName()) || cn.startsWith("java.lang.Thread")) continue;
			return cn.startsWith("net.mcreator.thebackwoods.");
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static final class RotVaultState {
		double validatedMaxHealth;
		double validatedHealth;
		int damageGraceTicks;
		int lastGraceTick = -1;
		int expectedGoals;
		int expectedTargets;
		boolean deathSequenceActive;
		boolean deathSequenceFinished;
	}

	private static final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, RotVaultState> ROT_SECURITY_VAULT = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	private static RotVaultState getVault(Entity entity) {
		return ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.computeIfAbsent(entity.getUUID(), k -> new RotVaultState());
	}

	public static void authorizeDamageGrace(Entity entity, int ticks) {
		if (entity == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, ticks);
		entity.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", v.damageGraceTicks);
	}

	public static void authorizeDeathSequenceActive(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		v.deathSequenceActive = true;
		entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", true);
	}

	public static void authorizeDeathSequenceFinished(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		v.deathSequenceFinished = true;
		entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished", true);
	}

	public static boolean isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() {
		return true;
	}

	public static boolean isShootingStarDamage(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
		if (ds == null) return false;
		try {
			if (ds.typeHolder() != null && ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().isPresent()) {
				String typeId = ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().get().location().toString().toLowerCase();
				if (typeId.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star") || typeId.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star_hit")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
		String msgId = ds.getMsgId();
		if (msgId != null) {
			String lower = msgId.toLowerCase();
			return lower.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star_hit")
				|| lower.equals("shooting_star_demo.shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_demo.shooting_star_hit")
				|| lower.equals("shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_hit");
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static boolean isRot(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		return entity instanceof RotEntity || entity.getClass().getSimpleName().contains("Rot");
	}

	public static boolean isVerdantEngine(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		String name = entity.getClass().getSimpleName();
		return name.contains("VerdantEngine") || name.contains("Verdant") || entity.getPersistentData().contains("verdant_state");
	}

	public static boolean isStructuralBoss(Entity entity) {
		return isRot(entity) || isVerdantEngine(entity);
	}

	public static boolean isBossDeathSequenceActive(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		if (isRot(entity)) {
			RotVaultState v = ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.get(entity.getUUID());
			if (v != null && v.deathSequenceActive) return true;
			boolean flagged = false;
			try {
				if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath)) flagged = true;
			} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			if (!flagged) {
				flagged = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
			}
			if (flagged) {
				if (!entity.level().isClientSide() && v != null && v.validatedMaxHealth >= 1.0 && v.validatedHealth > 20.0 && v.damageGraceTicks <= 0) {
					try {
						if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) rot.getEntityData().set(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", false);
					return false;
				}
				if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living && living.getHealth() <= 20.0F) {
					if (v != null) v.deathSequenceActive = true;
					return true;
				}
				return entity.level().isClientSide();
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
			return entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_death_sequence_active");
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static void enforceEntitySecurityTick(Entity entity) {
		if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || entity == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) return;
		RotDataGuardianForgeBusEvents.runEntitySecurityCheck(entity);
	}

	
	private static final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, Entity> PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	public static void registerProtectedDeathEntity(Entity entity) {
		if (entity != null && isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
			PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.put(entity.getUUID(), entity);
		}
	}

	public static void unregisterProtectedDeathEntity(Entity entity) {
		if (entity != null && isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) {
			if (isRot(entity)) {
				RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
				v.deathSequenceFinished = true;
			}
			PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.remove(entity.getUUID());
			ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.remove(entity.getUUID());
		}
	}

	
	public static void clearEntityRemoval(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return;
		try {
			java.lang.reflect.Method m = Entity.class.getDeclaredMethod("unsetRemoved");
			m.setAccessible(true);
			m.invoke(entity);
		} catch (Exception ignored) {
			try {
				java.lang.reflect.Field f = Entity.class.getDeclaredField("removalReason");
				f.setAccessible(true);
				f.set(entity, null);
			} catch (Exception ignored2) {}
		}
	}

	
	public static boolean isCommandTargetingBoss(String cmdLower) {
		if (cmdLower == null || cmdLower.isEmpty()) return false;
		
		// Direct entity namespace/name matching
		if (cmdLower.contains("the_backwoods:rot") || cmdLower.contains("the_backwoods:verdant_engine")
			|| cmdLower.matches(".*\\brot\\b.*") || cmdLower.matches(".*\\bverdant_engine\\b.*")) {
			return true;
		}

		// Selector analysis: only @e can target non-player entities like the boss (@a, @p, @r only target players)
		if (cmdLower.contains("@e")) {
			int atEIdx = cmdLower.indexOf("@e");
			int bracketStart = cmdLower.indexOf('[', atEIdx);
			int bracketEnd = (bracketStart != -1) ? cmdLower.indexOf(']', bracketStart) : -1;

			if (bracketStart != -1 && bracketEnd != -1 && bracketEnd > bracketStart) {
				String selectorArgs = cmdLower.substring(bracketStart + 1, bracketEnd);
				for (String arg : selectorArgs.split(",")) {
					String trimmed = arg.trim();
					if (trimmed.startsWith("type=")) {
						String typeVal = trimmed.substring(5).trim();
						// Negated type filter excludes the entity (e.g. type=!the_backwoods:rot or type=!player)
						if (typeVal.startsWith("!")) {
							return false;
						}
						// If an explicit type is given, only flag if it actually targets the boss
						return typeVal.equals("the_backwoods:rot")
							|| typeVal.equals("rot")
							|| typeVal.equals("the_backwoods:verdant_engine")
							|| typeVal.equals("verdant_engine");
					}
				}
			}
			// Unfiltered @e (e.g. "/kill @e") targets all entities including the boss
			return true;
		}

		return false;
	}

	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class RotDataGuardianForgeBusEvents {

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onCommandExecuted(CommandEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN) {
				return;
			}

			String rawCommand = event.getParseResults().getReader().getString();
			if (rawCommand == null) {
				return;
			}

			String cmdLower = rawCommand.trim().toLowerCase();

			boolean isTamperCmd = cmdLower.startsWith("attribute") || cmdLower.startsWith("/attribute")
					|| cmdLower.startsWith("data") || cmdLower.startsWith("/data")
					|| cmdLower.startsWith("kill") || cmdLower.startsWith("/kill");

			if (isTamperCmd) {
				if (isCommandTargetingBoss(cmdLower)) {
					if (event.getParseResults().getContext().getSource().getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
						ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) player.level();
						
						boolean bossExists = false;
						for (net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity ent : level.getAllEntities()) {
							if (isStructuralBoss(ent) && ent.isAlive()) {
								bossExists = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						
						if (bossExists) {
							event.setCanceled(true);
							if (SILENT_SECURITY_MODE) {
								player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal(MSG_COMMAND_BLOCKED));
							} else {
								triggerGlobalTamperBacklash(level, player, "COMMAND_INJECTION: " + rawCommand);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		
		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onLivingDeath(LivingDeathEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
				boolean isDying = isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity);
				boolean isAbsorbing = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");

				if (isDying || isAbsorbing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						if (isAbsorbing) {
							living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						} else {
							living.setHealth(1.0F);
						}
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			} else if (isRot(entity)) {
				boolean isDying = isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity);
				boolean shootingStarEnabled = isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled();
				boolean isAbsorbing = shootingStarEnabled && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed");
				net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds = event.getSource();
				String msgId = ds != null && ds.getMsgId() != null ? ds.getMsgId().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
				boolean isRailgun = shootingStarEnabled && (isAbsorbing || msgId.contains("railgun") || msgId.contains("star") || msgId.contains("shooting") || msgId.contains("gungnir") || msgId.contains("erasure"));

				boolean isPhasing = shootingStarEnabled && (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active") || entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer") > 0);
				if (isDying || isRailgun || isPhasing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						if (isRailgun || isPhasing) {
							living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 60.0);
						} else {
							living.setHealth(1.0F);
						}
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 40;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onEntityLeaveLevel(EntityLeaveLevelEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getLevel().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
				boolean isFinished = false;
				if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
					isFinished = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_death_sequence_finished");
				} else if (isRot(entity)) {
					RotVaultState v = ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.get(entity.getUUID());
					isFinished = (v != null && v.deathSequenceFinished);
					if (!isFinished && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished")) {
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished", false);
					}
				}
				if (!isFinished) {
					clearEntityRemoval(entity);
					if (entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel && serverLevel.getEntity(entity.getUUID()) == null) {
						try {
							serverLevel.addFreshEntity(entity);
						} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onServerTick(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.isEmpty()) return;

			java.util.List<java.util.UUID> toRemove = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
			for (java.util.Map.Entry<java.util.UUID, Entity> entry : PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.entrySet()) {
				Entity entity = entry.getValue();
				if (entity == null) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				// Allow Peaceful Mode to naturally despawn hostile bosses
				if (entity.level().getDifficulty() == net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				boolean isFinished = false;
				if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
					isFinished = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_death_sequence_finished");
				} else if (isRot(entity)) {
					RotVaultState v = ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.get(entity.getUUID());
					isFinished = (v != null && v.deathSequenceFinished);
					if (!isFinished && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished")) {
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished", false);
					}
				}

				if (isFinished) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.remove(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				// Hard Anti-Removal & Anti-Erasure Lock: Defeat victim.remove(RemovalReason.KILLED) / Erasure.WATCHED
				if (entity.isRemoved()) {
					try {
						clearEntityRemoval(entity);
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}

					if (entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						if (serverLevel.getEntity(entity.getUUID()) == null) {
							try {
								clearEntityRemoval(entity);
								serverLevel.addFreshEntity(entity);
							} catch (Exception ignored) {}
						}
					}
				}

				if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
					boolean isVerdantAbsorbing = isVerdantEngine(entity) && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");
					boolean isRotAbsorbing = isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() && isRot(entity) && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed");
					if (isVerdantAbsorbing || isRotAbsorbing) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					} else if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity)) {
						living.setHealth(1.0F);
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			}

			for (java.util.UUID uuid : toRemove) {
				PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.remove(uuid);
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			runEntitySecurityCheck(event.getEntity());
		}

		static void runEntitySecurityCheck(Entity entity) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || entity == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			if (isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
				registerProtectedDeathEntity(entity);
			}

			
			if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && !rot.level().isClientSide() && rot.isAlive()) {
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					return;
				}
				ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) rot.level();

				RotVaultState vault = getVault(rot);
				double validatedMaxHealth = vault.validatedMaxHealth;
				double validatedHealth = vault.validatedHealth;
				int damageGraceTicks = vault.damageGraceTicks;
				int expectedGoals = vault.expectedGoals;
				int expectedTargets = vault.expectedTargets;

				double currentBaseMaxHealth = rot.getAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH).getBaseValue();

				if (validatedMaxHealth < 1.0) {
					validatedMaxHealth = currentBaseMaxHealth;
					validatedHealth = rot.getHealth();
					expectedGoals = rot.goalSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					expectedTargets = rot.targetSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					vault.validatedMaxHealth = validatedMaxHealth;
					vault.validatedHealth = validatedHealth;
					vault.expectedGoals = expectedGoals;
					vault.expectedTargets = expectedTargets;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_max_health", validatedMaxHealth);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", validatedHealth);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_expected_goals", expectedGoals);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_expected_targets", expectedTargets);
				}

				if (currentBaseMaxHealth > validatedMaxHealth) {
					validatedMaxHealth = currentBaseMaxHealth;
					vault.validatedMaxHealth = validatedMaxHealth;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_max_health", validatedMaxHealth);
				} else if (currentBaseMaxHealth < validatedMaxHealth) {
					rot.getAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH).setBaseValue(validatedMaxHealth);
					triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_ATTRIBUTE_DECREASE");
				}

				if (vault.lastGraceTick != rot.tickCount) {
					vault.lastGraceTick = rot.tickCount;
					if (damageGraceTicks > 0) {
						damageGraceTicks--;
						vault.damageGraceTicks = damageGraceTicks;
						rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", damageGraceTicks);
					} else {
						rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 0);
					}
				}

				double currentHealth = rot.getHealth();
				if (currentHealth < validatedHealth) {
					if (damageGraceTicks > 0 || rot.hurtTime > 0 || rot.getLastHurtByMob() != null) {
						vault.validatedHealth = currentHealth;
						rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", currentHealth);
					} else {
						rot.setHealth((float) validatedHealth);
						rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", validatedHealth);
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_NBT_MODIFY");
					}
				} else if (currentHealth > validatedHealth) {
					vault.validatedHealth = currentHealth;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", currentHealth);
				}

				
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					registerProtectedDeathEntity(rot);
				}

				if (rot.tickCount % 5 == 0) {
					int currentGoals = rot.goalSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					int currentTargets = rot.targetSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					
					if (expectedGoals > 0 && currentGoals != expectedGoals) {
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_GOAL_INJECTION_DETECTED");
					}
					if (expectedTargets > 0 && currentTargets != expectedTargets) {
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_TARGET_INJECTION_DETECTED");
					}

					LivingEntity combatTarget = rot.getTarget();
					if (combatTarget != null) {
						String targetName = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(combatTarget.getType()).toString().toLowerCase();
						if (targetName.contains("rot") || targetName.contains("splinter")) {
							rot.setTarget(null);
							rot.setLastHurtByMob(null);
						} else if (combatTarget instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player) {
							boolean isDueling = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_dueling");
							if (!isDueling) {
								rot.setTarget(null);
								rot.setLastHurtByMob(null);
							}
						}
					}

					boolean isManifesting = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_manifesting");
					boolean isDying = false;
					try {
						isDying = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath);
					} catch (Exception e) {}
					if (!isDying) {
						isDying = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
					}
					if (!isManifesting && !isDying) {
						if (rot.isNoAi()) {
							rot.setNoAi(false);
							triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_NO_AI_FREEZE");
						}
						if (rot.isSilent()) {
							rot.setSilent(false);
						}
						if (rot.isInvisible()) {
							rot.setInvisible(false);
							triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_INVISIBILITY_GLITCH");
						}
					}
					if (rot.isVehicle()) {
						rot.ejectPassengers();
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_PASSENGER_GLITCH");
					}
					if (rot.isNoGravity() && !isDying) {
						rot.setNoGravity(false);
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_GRAVITY_DISABLE");
					}

					java.util.List<net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect>> debuffsToRemove = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
					for (MobEffectInstance effect : rot.getActiveEffects()) {
						String effId = effect.getEffect().unwrapKey().map(k -> k.location().toString().toLowerCase()).orElse("");
						if (effect.getAmplifier() >= 4 || effId.contains("torment") || effId.contains("insanity") || effId.contains("mind_control") || effId.contains("arphex")) {
							debuffsToRemove.add(effect.getEffect());
						}
					}
					for (net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect> effHolder : debuffsToRemove) {
						rot.removeEffect(effHolder);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static boolean isPlayerOrDebugAttack(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
			if (ds == null) return false;
			Entity attacker = ds.getEntity();
			Entity direct = ds.getDirectEntity();
			if (attacker instanceof Player player) {
				if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return true;
				ItemStack main = player.getMainHandItem();
				ItemStack off = player.getOffhandItem();
				String mainId = main.isEmpty() ? "" : net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(main.getItem()).toString().toLowerCase();
				String offId = off.isEmpty() ? "" : net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(off.getItem()).toString().toLowerCase();
				if (mainId.contains("null_pointer") || mainId.contains("debug") || mainId.contains("admin") || mainId.contains("kill")
					|| offId.contains("null_pointer") || offId.contains("debug") || offId.contains("admin") || offId.contains("kill")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (direct instanceof Player || attacker instanceof Player) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onLivingIncomingDamage(LivingIncomingDamageEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (!isStructuralBoss(entity)) return;

			if (entity.level().getDifficulty() == net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
				return;
			}

			registerProtectedDeathEntity(entity);

			net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds = event.getSource();
			float amount = event.getAmount();
			boolean isKillCmd = ds != null && ds.is(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageTypes.GENERIC_KILL);
			String msgId = ds != null && ds.getMsgId() != null ? ds.getMsgId().toLowerCase() : "";
			boolean isPlayerAttack = isPlayerOrDebugAttack(ds);
			boolean isRailgunAttack = !isPlayerAttack && (msgId.contains("railgun") || msgId.contains("shooting_star") || msgId.contains("erasure") || msgId.contains("star") || msgId.contains("gungnir")
				|| amount >= 500.0F || entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_hit_toggle"));

			if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
				if (isKillCmd) return;

				boolean isAlreadyAbsorbing = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");
				boolean isAlreadySupercharged = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_supercharged_mode");
				boolean isShootingStar = isShootingStarDamage(ds);

				// Railgun strike before supercharge -> Absorb & start 8s countdown!
				if (!isAlreadySupercharged && (isShootingStar || isAlreadyAbsorbing)) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 20;
					}
					if (!isAlreadyAbsorbing) {
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing", true);
						entity.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_railgun_heat_ticks", 160);
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_hit_toggle", false);
					}
					return;
				}

				// While absorbing -> completely immune
				if (isAlreadyAbsorbing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
					}
					return;
				}

				// Supercharged combat -> takes damage normally!
				return;
			} else if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) {
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (rot instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(1.0F);
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (isKillCmd) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					return;
				}
				if (isPlayerAttack) {
					RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
					v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 40);
					v.validatedHealth = Math.max(0.0, rot.getHealth() - amount);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 40);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", v.validatedHealth);
					return;
				}
				if (isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() && (isRailgunAttack || rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active"))) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (rot instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 40;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
						living.setInvisible(true);
						try {
							rot.getEntityData().set(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
						} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					}
					RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
					v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 60);
					v.validatedHealth = rot.getMaxHealth();
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 60.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 60);
					return;
				}
				RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
				v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 20);
				rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 20);
			}
		}

private static void triggerTamperBacklash(ServerLevel level, RotEntity rot, String reason) {
			boolean showVisEffects = !SILENT_SECURITY_MODE;

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_SOUND_EFFECTS) {
				level.playSound(null, rot.getX(), rot.getY(), rot.getZ(), SoundEvents.WITHER_SPAWN, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 3.0F, 0.5F);
				level.playSound(null, rot.getX(), rot.getY(), rot.getZ(), SoundEvents.LIGHTNING_BOLT_THUNDER, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 3.0F, 0.5F);
			}

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_PARTICLE_EFFECTS) {
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.DRAGON_BREATH, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 120, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 0.15);
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.PORTAL, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 150, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 0.5);
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 5, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			}

			AABB searchBox = rot.getBoundingBox().inflate(32.0);
			List<ServerPlayer> nearbyPlayers = level.getEntitiesOfClass(ServerPlayer.class, searchBox);
			boolean playerInvolved = false;
			for (ServerPlayer p : nearbyPlayers) {
				if (!p.isCreative() && !p.isSpectator()) {
					playerInvolved = true;
					if (ENABLE_LIGHTNING_STRIKES) {
						net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt lightning = new net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt(net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType.LIGHTNING_BOLT, level);
						lightning.setPos(p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ());
						level.addFreshEntity(lightning);
					}

					if (ENABLE_FEEDBACK_PENALTY) {
						applyLethalFeedback(p);
					}
				}
			}

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_BROADCAST_WARNINGS && playerInvolved) {
				String alertMsg = String.format(MSG_TAMPER_DETECTED, reason);
				level.getServer().getPlayerList().broadcastSystemMessage(Component.literal(alertMsg), false);
			}
		}

		private static void triggerGlobalTamperBacklash(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer player, String reason) {
			if (ENABLE_LIGHTNING_STRIKES) {
				net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt lightning = new net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt(net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType.LIGHTNING_BOLT, level);
				lightning.setPos(player.getX(), player.getY(), player.getZ());
				level.addFreshEntity(lightning);
			}

			if (ENABLE_FEEDBACK_PENALTY) {
				applyLethalFeedback(player);
			}
		}
		
		private static void applyLethalFeedback(ServerPlayer player) {
			net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.getHolder(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:cellular_collapse")).ifPresent(holder -> {
				player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(holder, 600, 1));
			});
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 600, 0));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.BLINDNESS, 600, 0));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.WITHER, 600, 3));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.WEAKNESS, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.HUNGER, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.POISON, 600, 2));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.CONFUSION, 600, 2));
			player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal(MSG_FEEDBACK_TRIGGERED));
		}
	}
} // 1.21.1

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderGuiEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLivingEvent;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class RotImpactFrames {
	public static boolean ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES = true; // Setting to enable/disable impact frames

	private static int impactTicks = 0;
	private static int maxImpactTicks = 0;
	private static int hurtCooldown = 0;
	private static int previousHurtTime = 0;

	// --- Hitstop Micro-Freeze State ---
	private static int hitstopTicks = 0;
	private static Vec3 frozenPlayerPos = null;
	private static float frozenPlayerYaw = 0.0F;
	private static float frozenPlayerPitch = 0.0F;
	private static java.util.Map<RotEntity, Vec3> frozenRotPositions = new java.util.HashMap<>();

	public static void trigger(int ticks) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES) {
			return;
		}
		impactTicks = ticks;
		maxImpactTicks = ticks;

		// Initiate Hitstop Micro-Freeze (3 ticks of freeze frame impact)
		hitstopTicks = Math.min(ticks, 3);
		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (minecraft.player != null) {
			frozenPlayerPos = minecraft.player.position();
			frozenPlayerYaw = minecraft.player.getYRot();
			frozenPlayerPitch = minecraft.player.getXRot();

			frozenRotPositions.clear();
			if (minecraft.level != null) {
				java.util.List<RotEntity> rots = minecraft.level.getEntitiesOfClass(
					RotEntity.class,
					minecraft.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(12.0D)
				);
				for (RotEntity rot : rots) {
					frozenRotPositions.put(rot, rot.position());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();

		if (minecraft.player == null || minecraft.level == null) {
			hitstopTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES) {
			impactTicks = 0;
			hitstopTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// --- Hitstop Micro-Freeze Execution ---
		if (hitstopTicks > 0) {
			hitstopTicks--;

			// Halt player momentum & position lock during micro-freeze
			minecraft.player.setDeltaMovement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			if (frozenPlayerPos != null) {
				minecraft.player.setPos(frozenPlayerPos.x, frozenPlayerPos.y, frozenPlayerPos.z);

				// Micro camera shake/jitter on impact
				double shakePitch = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
				double shakeYaw = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
				minecraft.player.setXRot((float) (frozenPlayerPitch + shakePitch));
				minecraft.player.setYRot((float) (frozenPlayerYaw + shakeYaw));
			}

			// Halt nearby Rot entities' momentum & lock position
			for (java.util.Map.Entry<RotEntity, Vec3> entry : frozenRotPositions.entrySet()) {
				RotEntity rot = entry.getKey();
				Vec3 pos = entry.getValue();
				if (rot != null && rot.isAlive()) {
					rot.setDeltaMovement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					if (pos != null) {
						rot.setPos(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
					}
				}
			}
		} else {
			frozenPlayerPos = null;
			frozenRotPositions.clear();
		}

		if (impactTicks > 0) {
			impactTicks--;
		}

		if (hurtCooldown > 0) {
			hurtCooldown--;
		}

		int currentHurtTime = minecraft.player.hurtTime;

		/*
		 * Detect the moment the player starts taking damage.
		 * hurtTime jumps above 0 when damage starts.
		 */
		boolean justGotHurt = currentHurtTime > 0 && previousHurtTime <= 0;

		previousHurtTime = currentHurtTime;

		if (!justGotHurt) {
			return;
		}

		if (hurtCooldown > 0) {
			return;
		}

		/*
		 * Find nearby Rot entities.
		 * This makes the impact frame happen only during Rot combat.
		 */
		java.util.List<RotEntity> rots = minecraft.level.getEntitiesOfClass(
				RotEntity.class,
				minecraft.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(12.0D)
		);

		if (!rots.isEmpty()) {
			boolean bestMoveTriggered = false;
			for (RotEntity rot : rots) {
				try {
					boolean isGroundCrushing = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_ground_crushing);
					boolean isOverhead = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_overhead);
					boolean isRiderCharging = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_rider_charging);

					if (isGroundCrushing || isOverhead || isRiderCharging) {
						bestMoveTriggered = true;
						break;
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					// Fallback in case of missing EntityData or init lag
				}
			}

			if (bestMoveTriggered) {
				trigger(8); // High-impact premium 8-tick cinematic flash!
				hurtCooldown = 15;
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLivingPre(RenderLivingEvent.Pre<?, ?> event) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES || impactTicks <= 0) {
			return;
		}

		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (minecraft.player == null) {
			return;
		}

		LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
		if (entity == null) {
			return;
		}

		boolean isRot = entity instanceof RotEntity;
		boolean isPlayer = entity == minecraft.player;

		if (!isRot && !isPlayer) {
			return;
		}

		// Calculate fighting-game hand-drawn style alternating high-contrast solid colors
		int color;
		if (impactTicks >= 5) {
			// Phase A: rot is solid bright vibrant red, player is solid pure white
			color = isRot ? 0xFFFF0000 : 0xFFFFFFFF;
		} else if (impactTicks >= 3) {
			// Phase B: rot is solid pure black, player is solid bright vibrant red
			color = isRot ? 0xFF000000 : 0xFFFF0000;
		} else {
			// Phase C: transition back - rot is solid pure white, player is solid pure black
			color = isRot ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF000000;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			// RenderType.eyes is fullbright, ignores light/shadows - perfect for solid flat silhouettes
			RenderType renderType = RenderType.eyes(getEntityTexture(event.getRenderer(), entity));
			VertexConsumer vertexConsumer = event.getMultiBufferSource().getBuffer(renderType);

			@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
			EntityModel<LivingEntity> model = (EntityModel<LivingEntity>) event.getRenderer().getModel();
			model.renderToBuffer(
				event.getPoseStack(),
				vertexConsumer,
				event.getPackedLight(),
				OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY,
				color
			);
		} catch (Exception e) {
			// Safety escape callback
		}
	}

	@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
	private static <T extends LivingEntity> ResourceLocation getEntityTexture(net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer<?> renderer, LivingEntity entity) {
		return ((net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer<T>) renderer).getTextureLocation((T) entity);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderGui(RenderGuiEvent.Post event) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES || impactTicks <= 0) {
			return;
		}

		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();

		if (minecraft.player == null || minecraft.level == null) {
			return;
		}

		GuiGraphics guiGraphics = event.getGuiGraphics();

		int width = minecraft.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
		int height = minecraft.getWindow().getGuiScaledHeight();

		float progress = maxImpactTicks <= 0 ? 1.0F : impactTicks / (float) maxImpactTicks;

		int baseColor;

		if (impactTicks % 2 == 0) {
			baseColor = 0x00FFFFFF; // white
		} else {
			baseColor = 0x00000000; // black
		}

		// 75% opacity maximum so that the stylized in-world silhouettes show through the high-contrast flash backgrounds
		int alpha = Math.min(190, Math.max(0, (int) (progress * 190.0F)));
		int color = (alpha << 24) | (baseColor & 0x00FFFFFF);

		guiGraphics.fill(0, 0, width, height, color);
	} // custom element, 1.21.1
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.EntityRenderersEvent;

import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.MobRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRendererProvider;
import net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelPart;
import net.minecraft.client.model.HierarchicalModel;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class RotRendererOverrider {

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void registerRenderers(EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event) {
		EntityType<RotEntity> entityType = (EntityType<RotEntity>) BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rot"));
		if (entityType != null) {
			event.registerEntityRenderer(entityType, CustomRotRenderer::new);
		}
	}

	public static class CustomRotRenderer extends MobRenderer<RotEntity, CustomRotRenderer.AnimatedModel> {
		private final ResourceLocation entityTexture = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/rotskin.png");
		public static final boolean ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT = true;
		public static final boolean PHASE_SHIFT_COMBAT = false;
		public static final float MAX_TRANSPARENCY = 0.80f; // 80% maximum transparency
		public static final float MIN_PHASE_OPACITY = 1.0f - MAX_TRANSPARENCY; // 0.20f opacity at max transparency
		public static final float CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS = 12.0f; // cinematic pause after damage before phase begins
		public static final float PHASE_IN_TICKS = 8.0f; // ticks to easeOutCirc into 80% transparency
		public static final float PHASE_OUT_TICKS = 15.0f; // ticks to easeOutQuart back to 100% opaque

		// Mathematical easing functions (no pulsing, smooth continuous curves)
		public static float easeOutCirc(float t) {
			t = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, t));
			return (float) Math.sqrt(1.0 - Math.pow(t - 1.0, 2.0));
		}

		public static float easeOutQuart(float t) {
			t = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, t));
			return (float) (1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - t, 4.0));
		}

		public static boolean isRotPhasing(RotEntity entity) {
			if (entity == null || !ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT) return false;
			return entity.isInvisible()
				|| entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active")
				|| entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer") > 0;
		}

		public static float calculatePhaseOpacity(RotEntity entity, float partialTick) {
			if (entity == null || !ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT) return 1.0f;
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("rot_phase_opacity")) {
				return (float) Math.max(MIN_PHASE_OPACITY, Math.min(1.0f, entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_opacity")));
			}
			if (!isRotPhasing(entity)) {
				return 1.0f;
			}

			double remaining = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer");
			double total = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks");
			if (total <= 0) total = 75.0;

			// Exact fractional elapsed time with partialTick for smooth 60fps+ rendering
			float currentTimer = (float) Math.max(0.0, remaining - (double) partialTick);
			float elapsed = (float) Math.max(0.0, total - currentTimer);

			// 0. Cinematic Delay: Rot remains solid immediately following damage impact
			if (elapsed < CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS) {
				return 1.0f;
			}

			// 1. Phase-In: easeOutCirc from 1.0f down to MIN_PHASE_OPACITY (80% transparent)
			float phaseElapsed = elapsed - CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS;
			if (phaseElapsed < PHASE_IN_TICKS) {
				float progress = phaseElapsed / PHASE_IN_TICKS;
				float curve = easeOutCirc(progress);
				return 1.0f - (1.0f - MIN_PHASE_OPACITY) * curve;
			}

			// 3. Phase-Out: easeOutQuart from MIN_PHASE_OPACITY back up to 1.0f (100% opaque)
			if (currentTimer < PHASE_OUT_TICKS) {
				float progress = 1.0f - (currentTimer / PHASE_OUT_TICKS);
				float curve = easeOutQuart(progress);
				return MIN_PHASE_OPACITY + (1.0f - MIN_PHASE_OPACITY) * curve;
			}

			// 2. Full Phase Hold: capped at exactly 80% transparency (0.20f opacity)
			return MIN_PHASE_OPACITY;
		}

		public CustomRotRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
			super(context, new AnimatedModel(context.bakeLayer(ModelRot.LAYER_LOCATION)), 0.7f);
			this.addLayer(new net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.layers.ItemInHandLayer<>(this, context.getItemInHandRenderer()));
		}

		private net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType getTranslucentRenderType(net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType originalType) {
			if (originalType == null) {
				return originalType;
			}
			try {
				String str = originalType.toString();
				int start = str.indexOf("Optional[");
				if (start != -1) {
					int end = str.indexOf("]", start);
					if (end != -1) {
						String locStr = str.substring(start + 9, end);
						ResourceLocation loc = ResourceLocation.parse(locStr);
						return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.itemEntityTranslucentCull(loc);
					}
				}
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
			return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.itemEntityTranslucentCull(entityTexture);
		}

		@Override
		public void render(RotEntity entity, float entityYaw, float partialTicks, PoseStack poseStack, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource bufferSource, int packedLight) {
			boolean isPhasing = isRotPhasing(entity);
			if (entity != null && entity.isInvisible() && !isPhasing) {
				return;
			}
			float opacity = calculatePhaseOpacity(entity, partialTicks);
			if (isPhasing && opacity < 0.999f) {
				net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource transparentBuffer = renderType -> {
					net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType translucentType = getTranslucentRenderType(renderType);
					return new AlphaVertexConsumer(bufferSource.getBuffer(translucentType), opacity);
				};
				super.render(entity, entityYaw, partialTicks, poseStack, transparentBuffer, packedLight);
			} else {
				super.render(entity, entityYaw, partialTicks, poseStack, bufferSource, packedLight);
			}
		}

		@Override
		protected boolean isBodyVisible(RotEntity entity) {
			if (isRotPhasing(entity)) {
				return true;
			}
			return super.isBodyVisible(entity);
		}

		@Override
		protected net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType getRenderType(RotEntity entity, boolean isBodyVisible, boolean translucent, boolean glowing) {
			if (isRotPhasing(entity) && calculatePhaseOpacity(entity, 0.0f) < 0.999f) {
				return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.entityTranslucent(this.getTextureLocation(entity));
			}
			return super.getRenderType(entity, isBodyVisible, translucent, glowing);
		}

		@Override
		protected void scale(RotEntity entity, PoseStack poseStack, float f) {
			poseStack.scale(1.25f, 1.25f, 1.25f);
		}

		@Override
		public ResourceLocation getTextureLocation(RotEntity entity) {
			return entityTexture;
		}

		public static final class AnimatedModel extends ModelRot<RotEntity> implements net.minecraft.client.model.ArmedModel {

				@Override

					return root;
				}

					public final net.minecraft.world.entity.AnimationState localDeathAnimState = new net.minecraft.world.entity.AnimationState();

					@Override

						this.root().getAllParts().forEach(ModelPart::resetPose);
						boolean isHeavyLeftPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_left_punching);
						boolean isHeavyRightPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_right_punching);
						boolean isUppercuttingLeft = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_left);
						boolean isUppercuttingRight = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_right);
						boolean isHeavyPunching = isHeavyLeftPunching || isHeavyRightPunching;
						boolean isUppercuttingActive = isUppercuttingLeft || isUppercuttingRight;

						boolean isLanding1 = false;
						boolean isLanding2 = false;
						try {
							isLanding1 = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand);
						} catch (Exception e) {}
						try {
							isLanding2 = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand2);
						} catch (Exception e) {}

						if (isLanding1) {
							entity.animationState21.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState21.stop();
						}

						if (isLanding2) {
							entity.animationState22.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState22.stop();
						}

						boolean isLanding = isLanding1 || isLanding2;

						if (isUppercuttingLeft) {
							entity.animationState20.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState20.stop();
						}

						if (isUppercuttingRight) {
							entity.animationState19.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState19.stop();
						}

						if (isHeavyLeftPunching) {
							entity.animationState17.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState17.stop();
						}

						if (isHeavyRightPunching) {
							entity.animationState18.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState18.stop();
						}

						boolean isDeath = false;
						try {
							isDeath = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath);
						} catch (Exception e) {}
						if (!isDeath) {
							isDeath = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
						}

						if (isDeath) {
							entity.animationState23.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
							localDeathAnimState.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState23.stop();
							localDeathAnimState.stop();
						}

						// [FIXED] Mapped rot_rider_kick to state 0 and checked WalkProcedure for conditional walking to prevent overlaps.
						this.animate(entity.animationState0, RotAnimation.rot_rider_kick, ageInTicks, 1f);
						if (net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.RotPlaybackConditionWalkProcedure.execute(entity) 
							&& !entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_blocking")
							&& !isHeavyPunching
							&& !isUppercuttingActive
							&& !isLanding
							&& !isDeath)
							this.animateWalk(RotAnimation.rot_walk, limbSwing, limbSwingAmount, 2f, 500f);

						this.animate(entity.animationState2, RotAnimation.rot_air_time, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState3, RotAnimation.rot_overhead, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState4, RotAnimation.rot_slam_crush, ageInTicks, 1f);
